title: Great Addition to Our Christmas Village
text: Great Addition to Our Christmas Village. This will make a great addition to our Christmas village! It's good and sturdy. The details are really nice. It does require batteries. It would be easier if it had a plug so we could control it with the light switch. Instead we have to manually turn on all of the items that use batteries. I am excited to put this in our display this year!
